image_description: A medium shot of two people in a boat holding a large sturgeon. The person in the foreground is wearing sunglasses and a beige jacket, smiling at the camera while gripping the fish's tail. A second person stands behind them. The sturgeon is large, silver-gray, with visible bony scutes along its side and a heterocercal tail. The background shows a river and a tree-lined shore.
